label: D2: back in S2 via a2 (common) right after an unrewarded S2 visit, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2. Its inputs there are last action = a2 and state = S2, so a common a2->S2 transition (just 2 of 5986 dev activations fall elsewhere). The reward input at this trial D1 must have been 0 (prev_reward 0 carries 99.4% of activation mass), and the previous trial must also have ended in S2 (prev_state != 1; prev rare or S1 visits almost never fire). So the feature reads: the agent went back to S2 after S2 just failed to pay. It also depends strongly on position in the episode: it never fires before ep_trial ~70 and has its highest rate at trials 80-99, so it may track elapsed time. Activations come with low value-head output (all below 7.13). Dev P=0.67, R=0.86, F1=0.76, mass recall 0.98. Leftover false positives include window-first trials whose previous state is unknown, plus some repeated unrewarded S2 visits. In the top examples the first unrewarded-to-S2 repeat reaches about 1.0 and later repeats are lower (about 0.5-0.6); this is from the examples only, not tested systematically. It does not fire at D1 or GO, on S1, on rare transitions, or after a rewarded trial. All variables are observed at D2, so no future variables are used.
